literal_meaning: বসে যাওয়া বা স্থির হয়ে যাওয়া (to sit or settle)
figurative_meaning_en: to become firmly established; to take hold or solidify
example_sentences_in_bangla: বুকে সর্দি বসেছে, তাই কাশি হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A cold has settled in my chest, so I'm coughing.
A fear has taken hold in my mind.
note: Often used in the context of illnesses like colds that persist, reflecting everyday Bengali health expressions.
